JOIN OUR RESEARCH

I am looking for highly motivated undergraduate and graduate students who are passionate about research in image/video processing, computer vision, and artificial intelligence. [2027级硕士研究生名额若干！欢迎对本课题组研究方向感兴趣的推免生联系！欢迎对本课题组研究方向感兴趣的本科生加入！]

当前招生单位：遥感信息工程学院
招生方向：
  • ✨课题方向1：面向真实场景的图像降采样和超分辨率重建
  • ✨课题方向2：基于生成式方法的遥感图像增强
  • ✨课题方向3：高动态范围（HDR）图像生成
  • ✨课题方向4：图像增强模型轻量化方法

Research Interest

My research lies at the intersection of visual perception, image processing, computer vision, and deep learning. I am particularly interested in developing advanced algorithms that bridge fundamental theory and real-world applications. Current research directions include:
  • ✨Image resampling, including image super-resolution and image downsampling
  • ✨Generative remote sensing image enhancement
  • ✨HDR image production
  • ✨Lightweight models for image enhancement
